$comment: Where AIOStreams Integrated touches or depends on upstream Viren070/AIOStreams. Read by scripts/upstream/sync.mjs to flag sync PRs; keep in step with docs/embedded-desktop/UPSTREAM-HOOKS.md. Paths are repository-relative; a trailing / matches a directory.

hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/core/src/utils/env.ts: imports desktop-env.ts before the environment is parsed; AIOSTREAMS_AUTH syntax
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/core/src/utils/http.ts: origin comparison before sending the internal secret
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/server/src/app.ts: installDesktop() before upstream middleware; sendFile dotfiles options
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/server/src/server.ts: loopback listen, ready event, WebSocket gate, stdin shutdown, deferred datasets
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/server/src/routes/api/proxy.ts: never forwards desktop cookies/auth or relays Set-Cookie/CSP
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/web/src/components/shell/update: defers the update prompt during playback in the integrated app
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/web/src/app/settings/apps.tsx: update channel labels (Preview instead of Nightly) in the integrated app
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/web/src/features/player/options: dashboard button in the player controls
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/web/src/lib/settings/index.ts: Discord presence and tracker reporting default off
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/desktop/app/src/main.rs: backend start, integrated version, integrated updater module
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/desktop/app/src/shell/tao_shell: backend origin trust, embedded message routing, shutdown
hookedUpstreamFiles.packages/desktop/app/Cargo.toml: Windows API features used by the integration
hookedUpstreamFiles..github/workflows/: upstream release/publish workflows are guarded to run only in Viren070/AIOStreams

shadowedUpstreamFiles.packages/desktop/app/src/updates.rs: kept byte-identical to upstream but not compiled; main.rs compiles updates_integrated.rs in its place. Review upstream changes here and port relevant fixes.

contracts.packages/core/src/utils/permissions.ts: AIOSTREAMS_AUTH_PERMISSIONS names mirrored in web/src/lib/embedded-accounts.ts and desktop/app/src/backend/accounts.rs
contracts.packages/core/src/utils/auth.ts: account/credential semantics used by the account check
contracts.packages/web/src/lib/input/actions.ts: player key bindings must not collide with Ctrl+, shortcuts
contracts.packages/web/src/lib/hosts/shell/: page side of the native bridge
contracts.packages/desktop/core/src/playback.rs: PlayerState idle/paused used for playback-aware updates
contracts.packages/server/src/routes/api/: JSON API used by the dashboard
contracts.packages/server/src/routes/jellyfin/: Jellyfin-compatible API used by the browsing client
contracts.packages/desktop/scripts/fetch-libs.ps1: pinned libmpv download used by package-windows.ps1

integrationReplacedFiles.README.md: the integrated project's landing page; upstream's README is linked from it
integrationReplacedFiles..github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/: issue forms for this distribution; upstream-only bugs are sent to Viren070/AIOStreams
